1: """Local structural/operational check. No evaluator answer key is present."""
2: import json
3: import math
4: import sys
5: from pathlib import Path
6: 
7: assert len(sys.argv) == 3, "usage: python tools/check.py ARTIFACT MODE"
8: path, mode = Path(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2]
9: assert mode in {"base", "payload", "routes", "timing", "mass", "image", "legacy", "external"}, "unknown check mode"
10: def bad_constant(value):
11:     raise ValueError("non-JSON numeric constant: " + value)
12: data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), parse_constant=bad_constant)
13: assert isinstance(data, dict)
14: assert set(data) == {"project", "status", "config", "history", "questions", "obligations", "evidence"}, "artifact schema"
15: assert isinstance(data["project"], str) and data["project"]
16: assert data["status"] in {"ready", "blocked"}, "draft is unfinished"
17: assert isinstance(data["config"], dict) and isinstance(data["history"], dict)
18: assert isinstance(data["questions"], list) and all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in data["questions"])
19: assert isinstance(data["obligations"], dict)
20: assert all(v in {"fulfilled", "cancelled", "not_triggered", "blocked"} for v in data["obligations"].values())
21: assert isinstance(data["evidence"], list) and data["evidence"] and all(isinstance(x, str) for x in data["evidence"])
22: assert len(data["evidence"]) == len(set(data["evidence"])), "duplicate citations"
23: assert (data["status"] == "blocked") == bool(data["questions"]), "hold requires an explicit question"
24: def finite(value):
25:     if isinstance(value, float):
26:         assert math.isfinite(value)
27:     if isinstance(value, dict):
28:         for child in value.values(): finite(child)
29:     if isinstance(value, list):
30:         for child in value: finite(child)
31: finite(data)
32: if mode == "payload":
33:     assert isinstance(data["config"].get("items"), list), "payload requires item list"
34:     assert len(data["config"]["items"]) == len(set(data["config"]["items"])), "duplicate payload item"
35: if mode == "routes":
36:     stops = data["config"].get("stops")
37:     assert isinstance(stops, list) and len(stops) >= 2 and all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in stops), "route shape"
38:     assert len(stops) == len(set(stops)), "repeated stop"
39: if mode == "timing":
40:     start, end = data["config"].get("start_minute"), data["config"].get("end_minute")
41:     assert isinstance(start, int) and isinstance(end, int) and 0 <= start < end <= 1440, "invalid daily interval"
42: if mode == "mass":
43:     assert isinstance(data["config"].get("mass_grams"), (int, float)), "mass is unresolved"
44:     assert data["config"]["mass_grams"] > 0
45: print("PASS " + mode + " " + path.as_posix())
